headline: UK Regulators Open Anti-Dumping Investigation into Chinese Robotic Mowers
summary: The UK Trade Remedies Authority launched an anti-dumping investigation into imports of low-cost Chinese robotic lawnmowers following an official complaint filed by Husqvarna.
why: Trade remedy inquiries can lead to tariffs that alter import costs, trade flows, and competitive dynamics in domestic retail sectors.

impacts.name: Husqvarna AB
impacts.why: An anti-dumping investigation into low-cost competitors protects domestic market share.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
